Record a person's decision on screened records

Source: R/doc-screen-resolve.R
gr_resolve.Rd

An "unclear" record is deferred to a person, and a record whose screening call failed has no decision at all. gr_resolve() is how that person's decision goes back into the run: the table takes the new decision, keeps the screener's beside it, and says who decided and when, and the trace records the same as a step of its own. forward, deferred and included are rebuilt from the new decisions.

Usage

gr_resolve(
  screening,
  document,
  decision,
  by,
  reason = NA_character_,
  at = Sys.time()
)

Arguments

screening

A gr_screening from gr_screen().

document

The records to resolve, by document (as in the table) or by document_id.

decision

"include" or "exclude": one for all of document, or one each.

by

Who decided: a name or initials. Required, because a decision with no one behind it cannot be checked or reported.

reason

Optional: why, one each or one for all.

at

When the decision was made. Defaults to now, and is recorded in UTC.

Value

The gr_screening, with table gaining screener_decision, resolved_by, resolved_at and resolved_reason the first time a record is resolved.

Details

The screener's own decision is kept in screener_decision, and gr_calibrate() compares against that one: a calibration over resolved records would otherwise credit the screener with the person's calls. gr_flow() counts the resolved records in a row of their own.

See also

gr_screen(), gr_flow(), gr_calibrate()

Other corpus functions: gr_calibrate(), gr_inventory(), gr_records(), gr_reference(), gr_reference_consensus(), gr_screen_sample_size(), gr_search()

Examples

cl <- gr_mock_client(function(messages, params) {
  '{"decision":"unclear","reason":"The excerpt does not say.",
    "criterion":null,"quote":null}'
})
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
writeLines("Participants were adults.", f)
s <- gr_screen(f, question = "Does the treatment work?",
               include = "Reports a randomised comparison", client = cl)
#> [1/1] file1b515554a7d8.txt
#> Extracting 'file1b515554a7d8.txt' with the 'txt' extractor.
#> Ingested 1 block(s), ~9 tokens (0 chars removed by cleaning).
#> Segmenting with 'structural' (cap 900 tokens, overlap 90).
#> Reading with 'screen' (head|1|none) over 1 chunk(s).
s$deferred
#> [1] "/tmp/Rtmp0cYkSI/file1b515554a7d8.txt"
s <- gr_resolve(s, basename(f), "include", by = "A. Reviewer",
                reason = "Methods section describes randomisation.")
s$table[, c("document", "decision", "screener_decision", "resolved_by")]
#>               document decision screener_decision resolved_by
#> 1 file1b515554a7d8.txt  include           unclear A. Reviewer
